MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH p,i,coalesce(i.timeOriginalEstimateS,0) AS e, collect(l.historyId) AS ids, coalesce(sum(l.seconds),0) AS s
WHERE e<>0 OR size(ids)>0
RETURN p.projectKey AS id, sum(s)-sum(e) AS value

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i, collect(l.historyId) AS ids
WHERE i.timeOriginalEstimateS IS NOT NULL OR size(ids)>0
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(ids)=0 THEN [null] ELSE ids END) AS t
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, t AS time_entry

MATCH (i:Issue) WHERE i.timeOriginalEstimateS IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS {MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0}
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue
MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE l.seconds>0 RETURN l.historyId AS time_entry
